## 🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?
NEUTRAL, style mixed / no clear leadership. Breadth: 2/11 sectors positive. Leadership: Narrow (3/5 Technology) — weak breadth and major divergence across large-cap names confirm a neutral stance.

2. Which sectors are leading?
Energy leads: SLB (1W: +9.01% | 1M: +15.00%) ABOVE TREND, CVX (1W: +5.78% | 1M: +12.20%) ABOVE TREND, MPC (1W: +6.83% | 1M: +24.14%) ABOVE TREND. Technology also showing leadership from cloud/AI names: CRM (1W: +24.95% | 1M: +34.53%) ABOVE TREND, NOW (1W: +8.68% | 1M: +15.73%) ABOVE TREND.

3. Which sectors are lagging?
Industrials lag: HON (1W: -6.62% | 1M: -16.92%) BELOW TREND, GE (1W: -7.02% | 1M: -12.66%) BELOW TREND. Consumer Discretionary weak: MAR (1W: -7.12% | 1M: -3.30%) BELOW TREND, RCL (1W: -8.41% | 1M: -18.46%) BELOW TREND.

## 📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

4. Top Performing Stocks?
Top 5: CRM (1W: +24.95% | 1M: +34.53%) ABOVE TREND, DE (1W: +10.06% | 1M: +13.12%) ABOVE TREND, SLB (1W: +9.01% | 1M: +15.00%) ABOVE TREND, NOW (1W: +8.68% | 1M: +15.73%) ABOVE TREND, NVDA (1W: +7.04% | 1M: +5.88%) ABOVE TREND. Leadership concentration: Narrow (3/5 Technology) — growth tilt but breadth too thin for a broad style call.

5. Worst Performing Stocks?
Bottom 5: HON (1W: -6.62% | 1M: -16.92%) BELOW TREND, ETN (1W: -6.82% | 1M: -11.91%) BELOW TREND, GE (1W: -7.02% | 1M: -12.66%) BELOW TREND, MNST (1W: -7.09% | 1M: -52.52%) BELOW TREND, MAR (1W: -7.12% | 1M: -3.30%) BELOW TREND — weakness concentrated in Industrials and select consumer names.

6. Momentum Stocks?
Strongest 1W movers: CRM (1W: +24.95%), DE (1W: +10.06%), SLB (1W: +9.01%), NOW (1W: +8.68%), NVDA (1W: +7.04%) — several major names showing 1W/1M confirmation but notable divergences: KHC (1W: +5.93% | 1M: -1.43%) POTENTIAL REVERSAL and V (1W: -1.43% | 1M: +2.57%) TREND EXHAUSTION signal tactical caution.

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

7. Technology Outlook?
Mixed but top-heavy: AAPL (1W: +3.67% | 1M: +5.13%) ABOVE TREND, MSFT (1W: +0.09% | 1M: +1.00%) ABOVE TREND, NVDA (1W: +7.04% | 1M: +5.88%) ABOVE TREND while GOOGL (1W: -1.43% | 1M: -10.73%) BELOW TREND and semis LRCX (1W: -7.85% | 1M: -9.26%) BELOW TREND show bifurcation; Tech is one of only two positive sectors this week.

8. Financials Outlook?
Soft overall: JPM (1W: -0.08% | 1M: -0.36%) BELOW TREND, PYPL (1W: -11.55% | 1M: -6.61%) BELOW TREND and trend-exhaustion among card names (V (1W: -1.43% | 1M: +2.57%) TREND EXHAUSTION, MA (1W: -1.73% | 1M: +2.98%) TREND EXHAUSTION) keep Financials under pressure.

9. Healthcare Outlook?
Mixed/defensive pockets: JNJ (1W: +1.93% | 1M: +8.49%) ABOVE TREND and PFE (1W: +2.54% | 1M: +14.21%) ABOVE TREND versus UNH (1W: -0.34% | 1M: -1.94%) BELOW TREND and LLY (1W: -2.47% | 1M: +4.13%) TREND EXHAUSTION — overall sector slightly soft this week.

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

10. Portfolio Recommendation?
Favor selective Energy and clear cloud/software winners (e.g., SLB (1W: +9.01% | 1M: +15.00%) ABOVE TREND, CVX (1W: +5.78% | 1M: +12.20%) ABOVE TREND, CRM (1W: +24.95% | 1M: +34.53%) ABOVE TREND) and reduce exposure to lagging Industrials and soft discretionary names (e.g., HON (1W: -6.62% | 1M: -16.92%) BELOW TREND, MAR (1W: -7.12% | 1M: -3.30%) BELOW TREND); style mixed / no clear leadership.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: CRM (1W: +24.95% | 1M: +34.53%) ABOVE TREND, DE (1W: +10.06% | 1M: +13.12%) ABOVE TREND, SLB (1W: +9.01% | 1M: +15.00%) ABOVE TREND. BEARISH: HON (1W: -6.62% | 1M: -16.92%) BELOW TREND, AMAT (1W: -8.61% | 1M: -19.70%) BELOW TREND, PYPL (1W: -11.55% | 1M: -6.61%) BELOW TREND.

12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: Energy (1W: +4.91% | 1M: +13.88%) — clear sector leader this week. BEARISH: Industrials (1W: -4.02% | 1M: -5.56%) and Consumer Discretionary (1W: -2.71% | 1M: -4.98%) — watch for continued weakness.

13. Key Levels & Triggers?
Watch CRM for consolidation breakout to confirm ABOVE TREND momentum; NVDA sustaining weekly gains would confirm continued tech leadership; HON failing to reclaim weekly losses signals further Industrials weakness; PYPL continuation of the 1W selloff would deepen Financials weakness.

## 📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?
NOW (+60): Cramer/buyback headline; NOW (1W: +8.68% | 1M: +15.73%) ABOVE TREND — sentiment confirmed by price. DE (+50): Baird upgrade; DE (1W: +10.06% | 1M: +13.12%) ABOVE TREND — sentiment confirmed. GE (+55): Navy contract; GE (1W: -7.02% | 1M: -12.66%) BELOW TREND — bullish headline but price is diverging, watch for follow-through.

15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?
PYPL (-60): Takeover fallout; PYPL (1W: -11.55% | 1M: -6.61%) BELOW TREND — sentiment confirmed and a downside risk. BA (-45): safety/fine headlines; BA (1W: -1.52% | 1M: -11.93%) BELOW TREND — sentiment confirmed. LOW (-60): cuts outlook; LOW not in top/bottom list here but bearish news aligns with sector weakness — monitor retailer discretionary exposure.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL, style mixed / no clear leadership; Breadth: 2/11 sectors positive; Leadership: Narrow (3/5 Technology). CRM (1W: +24.95% | 1M: +34.53%) ABOVE TREND, SLB (1W: +9.01% | 1M: +15.00%) ABOVE TREND and DE (1W: +10.06% | 1M: +13.12%) ABOVE TREND are showing strength. Key risk: weak overall breadth and several major-name divergences (PYPL BELOW TREND with negative sentiment; GE bullish headlines but BELOW TREND; V/MA/LLY trend exhaustion) — watch for trend confirmation before expanding exposure.
